title: uuencoding-multi: reassemble() .expect() should be unreachable! or proper error
description: reassemble.rs:150 uses .expect() for a branch documented as unreachable by construction (BTreeMap consistency guarantee). The doc says 'Never panics' but .expect() is a visible panic path for static analysis tools. Replace with unreachable!() with a comment, or restructure to return a proper error variant.
